archive_note: Full intermediate records are archived locally and remain accessible at the pre-cleanup commit; no history was rewritten. Final PR retains measurements rather than duplicate manifests/full traces.

methods.sampled_path: Sum of primitive endpoint displacements; lower bound on true travelled path, excludes within-primitive curvature.
methods.collision_proxy: Existing M0 eighth-tic displacement proxy: translation under 20% expected free displacement; not a ground-truth collision detector.
methods.near_zero_translation: Endpoint displacement under 1 map unit; static-wall proximity <=17 units corroborates contact for a radius-16 player, but does not classify engine collision events.
methods.reentries: 128-unit cell entries after removing consecutive duplicate cells, minus distinct entered cells, including initial cell.
methods.pose_recurrence: Decision endpoint within 24 units and 15 degrees of an endpoint at least six decisions earlier.
methods.new_cells: First-ever primitive endpoint in cell, relative to initial sample; not continuous path coverage.
methods.goal_distance: Euclidean straight-line distance, ignores walls; coarse BFS unresolved and not used.
methods.replay_inspection: Not performed by this script. See docs/m2-results.md for the separate manual sampled replay review.
